name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others. A 511-lesson, 20-phase, ~329-hour free open-source AI engineering curriculum.
one_liner: A complete, free, hands-on course that takes you from math basics to building and shipping real AI agents, one buildable lesson at a time.
buyer: Career-switchers and bootcamps who need a structured, credible AI curriculum and would pay for guidance, not the free content itself.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp uses it as its backbone syllabus and sells cohorts, mentorship, and job support on top.
A working developer follows it to build a portfolio of shipped AI artifacts for interviews.
A company uses selected phases as a standardized internal upskilling track for engineers.

money_ideas.idea: Paid cohorts: the lessons are free, but live mentorship, code review, and a certificate are not.
A subscription study group with weekly accountability and graded projects.

steal_this: Run a 6-week paid cohort through the agent-building phases. You supply structure, deadlines, and feedback; the free curriculum supplies the content.
